packageRules.description: Automerge non-major updates once every CI check passes. Renovate merges them itself (platformAutomerge is off), so it waits for all checks, not just the ones the main ruleset requires
hassfest and the HACS action pull floating images to validate against the latest rules, so pinning them adds nothing
Python upgrades need Home Assistant support first: approve them from the Dependency Dashboard and bump target-version in pyproject.toml in the same PR
MCR publishes no release timestamps, so the minimum release age could never be met
